*(Note: Figures cover completed months from January 1 through October 31, 2026, for your accessible brands.)*

  LEFT JOIN monthly AS b

SELECT

# Q3 2026 Performance Review and Q4 Action Plan

## Executive summary
- Net revenue for your premium denim brands reached $45,068.36 in Q3 2026, representing a 41.8% increase compared to Q2 2026 ($31,792.65) and an 88.3% increase year-over-year from Q3 2025 ($23,938.77).
- Growth was overwhelmingly driven by new customer acquisition (262 new active customers vs. 4 returning customers) and strong expansion in the core Jeans category.
- Search remains the dominant acquisition and revenue channel, generating 69.7% of total quarterly net revenue ($31,421.51).

## Key findings
- **Revenue Growth:** Q3 2026 net revenue grew to $45,068.36 across 266 orders, up from $31,792.65 across 191 orders in Q2 2026, while average order value remained stable at $169.43 (compared to $166.45 in Q2).
- **Category Performance:** Jeans generated $34,043.30 (75.5% of total net revenue), growing 42.7% over Q2 2026 ($23,861.50). Pants also saw strong growth, rising 105.6% to $2,467.63.
- **Customer Acquisition Mix:** Out of 266 active customers in Q3, 262 were first-time buyers, highlighting an exceptionally acquisition-heavy revenue profile with very low repeat purchase volume (only 4 returning customers).
- **Channel Concentration:** Search traffic drove $31,421.51 (69.7% of net revenue), followed by Organic ($5,829.60, 12.9%), Display ($3,080.42, 6.8%), Facebook ($2,762.96, 6.1%), and Email ($1,973.87, 4.4%).
- **Return Rates:** The overall quarterly return rate for Jeans was 9.1% (23 returned items out of 253 ordered), while smaller categories such as Tops & Tees (37.5% return rate) and Maternity (50.0% return rate) experienced high volatility on low volume.
